verdict.rationale: Crossplane has its own versioning mechanism for its automations: Composition Revisions manage changes to Compositions (docs-15), and packages can be built, updated, and pushed (docs-9). Its declarative APIs are described as explicit and auditable (docs-29), and the CLI can render functions offline for pre-merge testing (docs-7). Review and rollback, however, are only implied. Git and GitOps review are user-side workflows (comm-9, comm-10) and earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documented rollback to a prior Composition Revision, a first-party review/approval workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
